before: A room's close wrote a checkpoint of version 5: the Word file without its media parts, with labels and typer marks of the checkpoint's own namespace, and a manifest of the room facts Word has no place for. The next open loaded the Word file again, so a close gave the room's items new addresses, which refused a change made before the close as other-file, and dropped the facts the manifest did not hold, such as taken-back records, retracted words and compose ids. A room kept every hidden item for its whole life, and only a fold dropped them as a side effect. The host wrote the next file and deleted the log with no check that the file opens to the room.
after: A room's close writes a checkpoint of version 6: ordered/checkpoint.json holds every stored field of the room's document through one field table (the item list with its addresses, the suggestions, comments, counters, revision ids, resources, the last change counters and the side state), the room's last order number and a SHA-256 checksum of its body, and ordered/base.docx holds the Word package the room was first opened from, with its media by reference. The open checks every field, refuses a failure as checkpoint-manifest and a later version as checkpoint-version, and gives back the document the live room held. The document keeps the highest applied counter of each change id namespace (lastCounters), and a room refuses a change or a log entry at or under the counter its file holds, and a revert of a direct edit made before its file, as other-file; a session counts its change ids past those counters and names the room's file number it opened. closeOrderedRoom cleans the room (compactOrdered: the items no change can show again go, and the undo of own edits ends), writes the checkpoint, opens it as the next room does and compares it with the room field by field, and writes a Word backup; a file that does not open to the room is refused as OrderedRoomCloseError, and the room in memory is as it was after any outcome. A place in a removed unit is refused as unknown-address. An item's field that holds a new item's value is left out and reads back as that value, and a base element's shell (the element with no children) is saved as its id alone.
reason: Change messages, refusal messages, the change log and its kinds, and the Yjs document format do not change: the ordered room file is not one of the Yjs version fields, and other-file and unknown-address are refusal codes every client already reads. Every client opens the room's file after a close, so all copies hold the same cleaned list. Migration: start fresh rooms; a room file of version 5 still opens and writes version 6 at its next close. An engine of an earlier release refuses a file of version 6 by name (checkpoint-version), and a room admits only clients of its own code version. Ordered rooms are not deployed yet.
